items.title: Elasticsearch Internals: Inverted Index & Cluster Architecture
items.description: A deep dive into Elasticsearch internals — covering the inverted index structure, node roles, sharding, document write path, and search query execution.

items.title: Elasticsearch Senior Deep Dive: Performance & Scaling
items.description: Senior-level guide to Elasticsearch cluster engineering — covering memory management, the 32GB JVM heap boundary, Zen2 discovery, write/search optimization, and ILM.

items.title: Full-Text Search
items.description: Full-text search concepts, inverted indexes, relevance scoring, MySQL FULLTEXT, PostgreSQL tsvector, and Elasticsearch for advanced search.

items.title: Introduction to the ELK Stack
items.description: A comprehensive overview of the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and Beats — covering roles, system architecture, data flow, and primary use cases.

items.title: Search Systems
items.description: Design patterns for full-text search, autocomplete, faceted search, and search-as-you-type using Elasticsearch, inverted indexes, and Spring Data Elasticsearch.
